title: ServiceNow inks another AI partnership, this time with Anthropic
description: ServiceNow partners with Anthropic just a week after announcing a partnership with OpenAI as the company takes a multi-model approach.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: WhatsApp will now charge AI chatbots to operate in Italy
description: WhatsApp plans to charge developers of AI chatbots per message.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: AI data labeler Handshake buys  Cleanlab, an acquisition target of multiple others
description: The deal’s purpose is primarily to acquire talent, aka an acqui-hire, adding nine key Cleanlab employees to Handshake’s research organization.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Chrome takes on AI browsers with tighter Gemini integration, agentic features for autonomous tasks
description: Google Chrome is adding Gemini in the sidebar and is rolling out an agentic feature for AI Pro and Ultra users.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Tiny startup Arcee AI built a 400B-parameter open source LLM from scratch to best Meta’s Llama
description: 30-person startup Arcee AI has released a 400B model called Trinity, which it says is one of the biggest open source foundation models from a U.S. company.
author: Julie Bort

title: With Apple’s new Creator Studio Pro, AI is a tool to aid creation, not replace it
description: Apple’s Creator Studio Pro leverages AI to help creators with tedious tasks — like finding clips or building slides — without trying to do the work for them.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Modelence raises $3M to smooth out the vibe-coding stack
description: How do you build tooling for the AI software stack? A company called Modelence has an interesting answer.
author: Russell Brandom

title: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Plus-one passes are almost gone and only 3 days remain
description: The TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 plus-one passes at 50% off are almost sold out, and this deal ends in 3 days. Register here before this deal ends on Friday, January 30 at 11:59 p.m. PT.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: The AI infrastructure boom shows no sign of slowing down
description: ASML’s record orders show chipmakers are still betting big on AI data centers.
author: Russell Brandom

title: The conference where founders scale: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 tickets are now live at the lowest prices
description: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 unites 1,100 founders and investors in Boston on June 23 for a day focused on real-world scaling insights and networking that pushes the needle. Save up to $300 on your ticket.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: Anthropic, Apple, OpenAI CEOs condemn ICE violence, praise Trump
description: Anthropic's Dario Amodei and OpenAI's Sam Altman spoke out against ICE enforcement tactics following Minneapolis violence, with one addressing concerns publicly and the other in an internal message.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Waabi raises $1B and expands into robotaxis with Uber
description: Waabi has secured a $750 million Series C round to accelerate autonomous trucking, and another roughly $250 million commitment from Uber to deploy 25,000 robotaxis exclusively on its platform.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Google pitches Gemini to students studying for India’s most competitive college entrance exam
description: Google's launch of practice tests for JEE follows its recent move to offer full-length SAT practice tests in Gemini.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Everything you need to know about viral personal AI assistant Clawdbot (now Moltbot)
description: Personal AI assistant Moltbot —formerly Clawdbot — has gone viral in a matter of weeks. But there’s more you should know before jumping on the bandwagon.
author: Anna Heim

title: Anduril has invented a wild new drone-flying contest where jobs are the prize
description: This is a race series for software programmers and the brainchild of founder Palmer Luckey, he tells TechCrunch.
author: Julie Bort

title: Anthropic reportedly upped its latest raise to $20B
description: Anthropic looks to raise $20 billion at more than $300 billion valuation, according to reports.
author: Dominic-Madori Davis

title: Anthropic and OpenAI CEOs condemn ICE violence, praise Trump
description: Anthropic's Dario Amodei and OpenAI's Sam Altman spoke out against ICE enforcement tactics following Minneapolis violence, with one addressing concerns publicly and the other in an internal message.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Google’s more affordable AI Plus plan rolls out to all markets, including the U.S.
description: Gemini 3 Pro and other AI tools are now available globally through the Google AI Plus plan, which is $7.99 per month in the United States.
author: Sarah Perez

title: OpenAI launches Prism, a new AI workspace for scientists
description: OpenAI has launched a new scientific workspace program called Prism, which integrates AI into existing standards for composing research papers.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Google now lets users jump from AI Overviews into AI Mode conversations
description: The tech giant also announced that it's making Gemini 3 the new default model for AI Overviews globally.
author: Aisha Malik

title: Risotto raises $10M seed to use AI to make ticketing systems easier to use
description: "Our special sauce is the prompt libraries, the eval suites, and the thousands and thousands of real-world examples that the AI gets trained on to ensure it actually does what it's expected to do,” CEO Aron Solberg told TechCrunch.
author: Russell Brandom

title: Phoebe Gates and Sophia Kianni’s Phia raises $35M to ‘make shopping fun again’
description: “We are just at such a prime time of opportunity,” Gates said to explain the new fundraise. “Commerce itself for the consumer hasn’t really been adapted in the last 30 years, and the opportunity to make a truly personalized, end-to-end shopping experience is today.”
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Airtable jumps into the AI agent game with Superagent
description: SuperAgent is Airtable's first stand-alone product in its 13-year history, and signals both the company's ambitions and the reality of the current AI moment: Every serious software player is racing to prove they can deliver on agents.
author: Connie Loizos

title: China’s Moonshot releases a new open-source model Kimi K2.5 and a coding agent
description: The company said that the model was trained on 15 trillion mixed visual and text tokens.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Node-based design tool Flora raises $42M from Redpoint Ventures
description: Flora's node-based design tool is being used by companies like Pentagram and Lionsgate.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: ‘Among the worst we’ve seen’: report slams xAI’s Grok over child safety failures
description: “We assess a lot of AI chatbots at Common Sense Media, and they all have risks, but Grok is among the worst we’ve seen,” Robbie Torney of Common Sense Media said.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Qualcomm backs SpotDraft to scale on-device contract AI with valuation doubling toward $400M
description: SpotDraft now processes over 1 million contracts annually using its AI tool, with contract volumes up 173% year-over-year.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: YouTubers sue Snap for alleged copyright infringement in training its AI models
description: The YouTubers claim Snap, like others, used AI datasets meant for research and academic use to train its AI models.
author: Sarah Perez

title: AI startup CVector raises $5M for its industrial ‘nervous system’
description: Industrial AI startup CVector built a brain and nervous system for big industry. Now, founders Richard Zhang and Tyler Ruggles are tasked with a bigger challenge: showing customers and investors how this AI-powered software layer translates to real savings on an industrial scale.  The New York-based startup has had some success following its pre-seed funding […]
author: Sean O'Kane

title: Anthropic launches interactive Claude apps, including Slack and other workplace tools
description: Claude users will now be able to call up interactive apps inside the chatbot interface, with Cowork integration coming soon.
author: Russell Brandom
